app.title: Feralis
hud.controls: Arrows or WASD to move · E or Space to interact · The game saves itself
storage.fallback: This browser will not grant persistent storage: your game is kept in local memory and may be lost if you clear the site data.
world.sign.beach: You woke up here, with no memories and no Ferals. The path north leads into the woods.
world.sign.totem: A wooden deck, laid by someone before you. It would make a good Clearing, once you know how to build one.
world.sign.forest: Dense woods. Trees cannot be crossed, and neither can boulders: you will need Ferals with the right work skills.
world.sign.highland: Highland. The air turns cold and the cliffs close the way: from here on you will need equipment.
